tool_input.description: Check formatting of the stringify file

result:
Running `rustfmt` was denied, and `cargo fmt` would reformat the whole crate, so I'm leaving formatting as is. Final check of the test run and clippy has already passed.

`JSON.stringify` is implemented in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/json/stringify.rs`. The `json/stringify/` run is at 108 of 134 passing, up from 8 on main, and clippy is clean.

The 26 remaining failures are outside this file:
- `length.js` (2 runs): `generated.rs` registers `stringify` with `length: 1`, and the spec requires 3.
- The Proxy `[[Get]]` tests (16 runs of "not implemented") hit an engine gap: Proxy `[[Get]]` is unimplemented, so they throw the not-implemented error.
- The rest are other not-implemented paths: `BigInt`, `RegExp` and `Array.prototype.reverse` in the test262 suite.

I did not run `rustfmt`/`cargo fmt` (the first was denied, and the second would touch files outside scope), so formatting is unchecked. The helpers `serialize_json_property`, `serialize_json_object`, `serialize_json_array`, `quote_json_string` and `unicode_escape` are private to this file; other built-ins may need them later, so they may be worth moving into `support/` at that point.

BLOCKED: `length: 1` for JSON.stringify in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/generated.rs must be 3 (outside this ticket's file scope); Proxy [[Get]] is not implemented in the engine (needed by 16 of the test262 runs)
